title: Adjournment debate on migrant domestic workers and caregiving support
what_it_is: An adjournment motion debate in which Ms Yeo Wan Ling set out proposals to support migrant domestic workers and caregiving families, and Senior Parliamentary Secretary Shawn Huang responded on behalf of the Government.
why_it_matters: For households with caregiving needs, the transcript records that the Home Caregiving Grant will increase to up to $600 per month and the per capita household income threshold will rise to $4,800 from April 2026. It also records that eligible households pay a $60 concessionary levy instead of $300, and that the minimum annual medical insurance claim limit for MDWs is $60,000. The record does not state whether the Member's other proposals will be implemented.

key_points.point: Ms Yeo said the number of migrant domestic workers in Singapore is more than 308,000, up from about 247,000 five years ago.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
key_points.quote: more than 308,000 migrant domestic workers (MDWs) in Singapore today, up from about 247,000 just five years ago

key_points.point: Ms Yeo said Singapore had 1.46 million households in 2024 and 27% had at least one resident aged 65 and above.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
key_points.quote: In 2024, Singapore had 1.46 million households and 27% had at least one resident aged 65 and above.

key_points.point: Ms Yeo asked for the Caregivers Training Grant to be expanded to include advanced home care and language training.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
key_points.quote: My ask is to expand the Caregivers Training Grant to include advanced home care as well as language training

key_points.point: Ms Yeo asked for professional standards for employment agencies to be raised, especially for complex care households.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
key_points.quote: raise professional standards for employment agencies, especially in handling complex care households

key_points.point: Ms Yeo asked for a Primary Care Plan-type scheme to be extended to migrant domestic workers.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
key_points.quote: to extend a Primary Care Plan (PCP)-type scheme to our MDWs

key_points.point: Ms Yeo asked for mental health screening and counselling to be made part of a national MDW support framework.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
key_points.quote: make mental health screening and counselling part of a national MDW support framework

key_points.point: Ms Yeo asked for regulated, care-focused part-time MDW and home care pathways to be developed.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
key_points.quote: develop regulated, care-focused part-time MDWs and home care pathways

key_points.point: Ms Yeo asked for levy and subsidy eligibility to be reviewed to reflect real dependency, not just age.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
key_points.quote: review levy and subsidy eligibility to reflect real dependency, not just age

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said the MDW population grew by around 3% per year on average between 2011 and 2025, to about 300,000 today.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: Between 2011 and 2025, the MDW population grew by around 3% per year on average, to about 300,000 today.

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said the Caregivers Training Grant was enhanced from 1 April 2024, increasing from $200 to $400 per year per care recipient.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: The CTG was enhanced from 1 April 2024, increasing from $200 to $400 per year, per care recipient.

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said the Agency for Integrated Care offers over 240 courses covering a range of caregiving training skills.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: offers over 240 courses covering a range of caregiving training skills

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said employers must provide at least one rest day per month that cannot be compensated away.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: Employers must provide at least one rest day per month, that cannot be compensated away

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said MOM has a dedicated helpline with native speakers for MDWs in distress.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: MOM has a dedicated helpline with native speakers for MDWs in distress.

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said the Home Caregiving Grant will be enhanced by increasing the monthly payout to up to $600 and raising the per capita household income threshold to $4,800.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: first increasing the monthly payout from up to $400 per month to up to $600 per month; and raising the per capita household income (PCHI) eligibility threshold, from $3,600 to $4,800.

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said the Home Caregiving Grant enhancements will take effect from April 2026.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: The enhancements to HCG will take effect from April 2026.

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said local households with caregiving needs enjoy a concessionary levy rate of $60 per month instead of $300.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: local households with caregiving needs enjoy a concessionary levy rate of $60 per month, instead of $300.

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said around 72% of households hiring MDWs already benefit from the levy concession.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: around 72% of households hiring MDWs already benefit from the levy concession

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said the minimum annual claim limit for MDW medical insurance was raised to $60,000 in 2023.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: The minimum annual claim limit was raised to $60,000 in 2023.

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said the $60,000 limit covers 99% of inpatient and day surgery bills incurred by MDWs in public healthcare institutions.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: covers 99% of inpatient and day surgery bills incurred by MDWs in the public healthcare institutions.

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said the objective of the Primary Care Plan is to provide migrant workers with accessible primary healthcare.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: the objective of the PCP is to provide migrant workers with accessible primary healthcare

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said more than 80% of employers hire their MDWs with the help of an employment agency.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: Today, more than 80% of employers hire their MDWs with the help of an employment agency.

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said employment agencies that breach guidelines may be issued demerit points, which may lead to suspension or revocation of their licence.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: employment agencies found to have breached these guidelines will be issued with demerit points, which may result in the eventual suspension or revocation of the employment agency licence.

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said employers may use the FDW eService portal to access information about MDWs' past work performance.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: Employers may use the FDW eService portal to access information about MDWs' past work performance

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said MOM provides an online employment agency directory for households looking to engage an employment agency's service.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: MOM provides an online employment agency directory to provide information to households looking to engage an employment agency's service

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said first-time employers are required to attend the Employers' Orientation Programme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: First-time employers are required to attend the Employers' Orientation Programme

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said MDWs must go through the Settling-in Programme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: MDWs, in turn, must go through the Settling-in Programme

key_points.point: Mr Shawn Huang said the Government will continue to find ways to safeguard the interests of MDW employers while protecting the well-being of MDWs.
key_points.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
key_points.quote: We will continue to find ways to safeguard the interests of MDW employers while protecting the well-being of MDWs.

key_points.point: The Speaker informed Members that the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 12.30 pm.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 12.30 pm.

key_points.point: Parliament was adjourned at 7.28 pm.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: Adjourned accordingly at 7.28 pm.

what_happens_next: Parliament was adjourned at 7.28 pm; the Speaker informed Members that the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 12.30 pm.
not_said: Whether the Caregivers Training Grant will be expanded to include advanced home care and language training.
Whether professional standards for employment agencies will be raised for complex care households.
Whether a Primary Care Plan-type scheme will be extended to migrant domestic workers.
Whether mental health screening and counselling will be made part of a national MDW support framework.
Whether regulated, care-focused part-time MDW and home care pathways will be developed.
Whether levy and subsidy eligibility will be reviewed to reflect real dependency, not just age.
What specific resources would be provided to scale up social and recreational activities for MDWs.
How any part-time care pathways would be regulated and contracted.
